pages.text: A propeller and any boat make a motorboat that keeps its wood; a bamboo raft makes a motor raft. Chest boats can't.

**Driving:** press forward to start cruising, back to stop. It cuts out when out of fuel, stuck, or when you get out. Seats two.

**Fuel:** shift + right-click (or your inventory key while riding) for a **fuel slot** (8 times furnace time) and a **storage slot**. It only lights fuel while cruising.
